# Machine shop guides

> Free tools for small machine shops: a CMMC Level 1 self-assessment checklist (the 15 FAR 52.204-21 requirements, met or not met, with an evidence worksheet), an SPRS score calculator for the 110 NIST SP 800-171 requirements (DoD Assessment Methodology, 110 minus 5/3/1 per gap), a job-shop quote calculator from the shop's own rates, and guides to CMMC Level 1 vs Level 2, SSPs and POA&Ms, and pricing a machined part.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, compliance, financial or engineering advice. A calculated score is a self-check, not a CMMC assessment or certification; not affiliated with or endorsed by the DoD. CMMC status on the pages was checked 24 November 2026 (Phase 2 suspended since 13 July 2026).

## Tools

- [CMMC Level 1 self-assessment checklist](https://marisstella.app/machine-shop-guides/cmmc-level-1-self-assessment.html)
- [SPRS score calculator](https://marisstella.app/machine-shop-guides/sprs-score-calculator.html)
- [Job-shop quote calculator](https://marisstella.app/machine-shop-guides/job-shop-quote-calculator.html)

## Guides

- [CMMC Level 1 vs Level 2 for a small machine shop](https://marisstella.app/machine-shop-guides/cmmc-level-1-vs-level-2.html)

- [How to price a machined part](https://marisstella.app/machine-shop-guides/how-to-price-a-machined-part.html)
